name: palladin-agent
description: Preview of secure Palladin credential injection into an exact browser tab.

interface.longDescription: Palladin lets Codex prepare an exact Chrome tab and request credential injection through the paired Palladin extension. Secrets remain inside the native runtime and authenticated extension transport.
defaultPrompt: Sign me in to this website with Palladin.
Open the login page and use my Palladin account.
Use Palladin to sign in on this Chrome tab.
